newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Sydkraft Q1 profit seen surging.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Sydkraft Q1 profit seen surging.

text.p: Swedish power group Sydkraft is expected to more than triple its first quarter profit after financial items to 3.29 billion crowns from 976 million, a Reuters poll of five analysts showed on Wednesday.
The boost largely stems from a capital gain of 2.2 billion crowns, deriving from the sale of shares in German utility VEBA.
The forecasts ranged from 3.16 billion crowns to 3.36 billion.

For the full year 1997, analysts expect Sydkraft's profit after financial items to rise to 4.99 billion crowns, including the capital gain, from 2.50 billion. For 1998, the profit is seen landing at 3.21 billion crowns.
Sydkraft will release its first quarter report on Friday May 30.
Analysts interviewed for the poll came from Aros, CSFB,
